usedFor: CompanyCam holds job site projects, and Google Drive gets a folder from “New Project” through “Create Folder”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in CompanyCam, then “Create Folder” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Every new job gets its own Drive folder for paperwork, ready before the first photo is taken.

watchOut: “Copy a File” on “New Photo” in CompanyCam runs once per photo, so a busy job site means many copies.
